title: Dashboard overview manual interaction and empty-state coverage
intent: Validate the landing dashboard as the first operational screen with useful empty states, actionable project/doc/run shortcuts, mobile layout, and no internal error leakage.
acceptance: Manual e2e opens dashboard at desktop and mobile and exercises every visible shortcut
Empty projects/tasks/docs/runs state explains next action without marketing copy
Error states never expose internal stack or unreachable labels as primary content
Metric cards link to filtered destination screens
anti_patterns: Blank content area with counters only
Internal error text visible in dashboard chrome
Cards inside cards or oversized decorative hero treatment
Mobile sidebar/header occluding dashboard content
interactions: simulate empty data and API error
manual_simulation: Keyboard tab through metric and shortcut controls
Force failed dashboard loader and inspect recovery copy
incentive: First screen must prove Fulcrum is a usable workflow console, not a status placeholder.

title: Global shell navigation, scope switcher, and keyboard access coverage
intent: Inventory and test the persistent shell controls that connect every route: sidebar, topbar scope, skip link, command palette, active route states, and mobile navigation.
acceptance: Every primary route is reachable by pointer and keyboard from the shell
Active section and current project/workspace scope remain visible
Mobile navigation opens, closes, and returns focus correctly
Command palette can navigate to equivalent destinations without stale labels
anti_patterns: Route list with inactive or dead links
Keyboard trap in command dialog
Scope labels that are decorative but not actionable
Mobile nav overlapping page forms
manual_simulation: Run one pass from root through all primary nav links
incentive: All deeper workflow screens depend on reliable global navigation.

title: Command palette action, search, and state coverage
intent: Treat the command palette as a first-class workflow accelerator and manually simulate open/search/execute paths across projects, docs, runs, settings, and task actions.
acceptance: Palette opens via keyboard and button from all major routes
Search filters commands predictably with no stale destination labels
Executing commands preserves scope and closes the palette with focus restored
Empty/no-results and loading states are visible and useful
anti_patterns: Palette only navigates but cannot launch workflow actions
Unlabeled shortcut-only commands
No mobile fallback for command access
Focus lost to page top after command execution
manual_simulation: Record commands from dashboard, project board, docs, and settings
Verify screen reader labels for command items
Compare command inventory to route inventory
incentive: Power-user navigation should reduce route sprawl friction.

title: Projects index list, filters, and blank-state coverage
intent: Validate the projects index as the human entry point to workspaces/projects with list density, filtering, creation CTA, active-project affordance, empty state, and mobile behavior.
acceptance: Empty state drives create/import/open existing project actions
Project cards or rows expose status, counts, latest activity, and primary next action
Search/filter controls have visible applied-state and reset behavior
Mobile list keeps actions reachable without horizontal overflow
anti_patterns: Blank content area after successful 200
Project tiles with no operational metadata
Create button hidden below fold on mobile
Filters with no empty/no-match copy
manual_simulation: Use seeded zero-project and multi-project data
incentive: Project selection gates most of Fulcrum’s workflow surface.

title: Project create/edit form validation and recovery coverage
intent: Manually test project creation and editing controls, including validation, repository/path inputs, metadata, submit progress, cancellation, and server failure recovery.
acceptance: Required fields show inline validation before and after submit
Repository/path fields explain local-first expectations and invalid paths
Submit disabled/loading/error/success states are distinct
Cancel returns to prior context without data loss surprise
anti_patterns: HTTP 500 page for validation or persistence errors
Generic invalid input text with no recovery
Long forms without grouped sections
Mobile keyboard covering submit/error region
incentive: Project creation must be resilient because it starts the full workflow graph.

title: Project overview summary, next-action, and cross-link coverage
intent: Validate /projects/[id] as a dense operational overview linking board, docs, runs, repos, reports, settings, and current blockers.
acceptance: Overview exposes project health, work counts, docs, runs, repo status, and next recommended actions
Each summary module links to a filtered/scoped destination
Missing data has clear empty modules instead of invisible sections
Mobile order prioritizes next action and current blockers
anti_patterns: Marketing dashboard layout instead of project operations
Duplicate cards with no cross-links
Danger actions near routine actions
Data shown without last-updated or state context
manual_simulation: Seed project with no tasks and with active runs
incentive: Project overview should prevent users from hunting through separate apps for status.

title: Kanban board drag, keyboard, run controls, and empty-lane coverage
intent: Manually simulate board column interactions including drag/drop, keyboard move, lane empty states, WIP indicators, task quick actions, and agent run preview entry points.
acceptance: Drag and keyboard moves update status with optimistic and rollback states
Empty lanes explain how to add or filter work
Run action opens dependency disclosure before execution
Board remains usable at mobile widths with alternate layout or clear overflow behavior
anti_patterns: Pointer-only drag behavior
Silent failure on move rollback
Run button starts agents without dependency impact preview
Columns squeeze into unreadable mobile cards
manual_simulation: Use sample board with empty and over-limit columns
Force API error on status move
incentive: Board is the main place humans dispatch work and agents.

title: Project task list grouping, inline edit, and bulk action coverage
intent: Validate list view controls for grouped task scanning, inline edits, selection, bulk actions, filtering, sorting, and empty/error states.
acceptance: List grouping and sorting controls visibly alter row order
Inline status/priority/assignee edits have save/loading/error feedback
Bulk selection works with keyboard and explains affected count
No-results state preserves filter reset path
anti_patterns: Hidden row actions requiring hover only
Bulk bar with destructive action too close to routine edits
Filter controls detached from result count
Rows overflow horizontally on mobile
manual_simulation: Mobile screenshot with long task names
incentive: List view must support repeated PM maintenance without board drag friction.

title: Spreadsheet table sort, column, inline edit, and overflow coverage
intent: Manually simulate spreadsheet-style task management, including sortable columns, custom fields, horizontal overflow, keyboard navigation, and bulk edits.
acceptance: Columns sort and preserve clear active-sort state
Inline cells support keyboard entry, cancel, save, and validation
Horizontal overflow has stable sticky identifiers/actions
Custom-field edits respect field type and dependency rules
anti_patterns: Table unusable on mobile without alternate view
Ambiguous unsaved cell edits
Sticky columns overlapping action menus
Custom fields rendered as plain text only
manual_simulation: Use long titles and many custom fields
Force failed cell save and rollback
incentive: Spreadsheet parity is expected by PM users migrating from Plane/Linear-style tools.

title: Gantt and calendar scheduling interaction coverage
intent: Validate date-driven project views for task scheduling, drag reschedule, dependency visibility, empty dates, timezone behavior, and mobile fallback.
acceptance: Users can navigate month/week/time ranges and see active range context
Drag/reschedule and date edits have optimistic, rollback, and validation states
Unscheduled tasks remain discoverable with assign-date controls
Mobile provides list/agenda fallback instead of tiny grid only
anti_patterns: Calendar cells too small for task labels
Date changes without timezone or save feedback
Unscheduled work hidden offscreen
Gantt bars without accessible text equivalent
manual_simulation: Seed overdue, due today, multi-day, and unscheduled tasks
incentive: Scheduling views make project plans actionable beyond static boards.

title: Task detail fields, comments, activity, watchers, and run action coverage
intent: Manually test the task detail panel/page as the complete work item surface across metadata, description, relationships, comments, activity, watchers, time, and agent controls.
acceptance: All editable fields show dirty/save/error states
Comments and activity feed preserve ordering and attribution
Run/QA/UAT actions show trace and dependency impact before dispatch
Mobile layout keeps description, metadata, and activity reachable without tabs hiding state
anti_patterns: Task detail as read-only summary
Agent actions mixed with routine edits without confirmation
Comments without empty/error retry states
Activity feed that hides failed actions
manual_simulation: Seed task with no comments and with long activity
incentive: Task detail is the human/agent handoff contract.

title: Task quick create and sprint planning tray coverage
intent: Validate quick task creation from board/list/table/planning contexts, including required fields, sprint/module/cycle assignment, recurrence, and failure recovery.
acceptance: Quick create works from each PM view without losing current filter/scope
Validation and duplicate prevention are clear
Sprint/module/cycle assignments are visible before submit
Recurring tasks explain schedule and generated instances
anti_patterns: Create modal with hidden required project scope
Quick create unavailable from empty lanes
Recurrence config with no preview
Submit failure clears entered text
manual_simulation: Use long title and no title
incentive: Fast capture prevents users from leaving Fulcrum for simple task entry.

title: Workflow rules, automations, and field dependency builder coverage
intent: Manually simulate configuration of task workflow rules, automations, conditional fields, and validation impact across project settings and task forms.
acceptance: Rule builders expose trigger, condition, action, preview, save, disable, and delete states
Invalid rule combinations are blocked with specific recovery
Task forms reflect field dependencies immediately and accessibly
Automation failures are visible in related task/activity surfaces
anti_patterns: Raw JSON-only automation editing
Rules save silently with no preview
Conditional required fields fail only on final submit
Destructive delete without confirmation
incentive: Workflow automation is a differentiator only if humans can configure and trust it.

title: Documents index, global docs, tree navigation, and empty-state coverage
intent: Validate documents browsing across project/global spaces with tree navigation, search, create actions, backlinks visibility, empty folders, and mobile behavior.
acceptance: Project and global doc spaces are visually distinct and cross-linked
Tree expand/collapse, selection, empty folders, and create-child controls work by keyboard
Blank doc spaces drive create/import/template actions
Mobile sidebar becomes usable drawer or stacked navigator
anti_patterns: Blank content area after docs route loads
Tree only usable by pointer
Global/project docs mixed without scope label
Mobile doc tree consumes all viewport
manual_simulation: Seed nested docs and empty workspace
incentive: Docs are the start of W1 and W3 planning workflows.

title: Rich document editor block, slash menu, autosave, and attachment coverage
intent: Manually simulate the Tiptap editor controls inherited from Docmost-style requirements, including slash blocks, comments, embeds, attachments, autosave, and recovery states.
acceptance: All supported block families can be inserted, edited, reordered, and deleted
Autosave has visible saved/saving/error/offline states
Attachment upload/download errors are recoverable
Frontmatter form and YAML toggle preserve equivalent data
anti_patterns: Editor toolbar with untested buttons
Autosave invisible until data loss
YAML toggle corrupts frontmatter
Embeds render as blank boxes without fallback
manual_simulation: Create one document containing every block family
Capture mobile editor and long code/table blocks
incentive: Rich docs must be good enough to replace external knowledge tools.

title: Document version history, diff, restore, comments, and backlinks coverage
intent: Validate document collaboration controls: version timeline, inline diff, restore, comments, resolve states, backlinks, and planning-context conversion.
acceptance: Version timeline shows author/time/change summary and selectable diffs
Restore requires confirmation and records resulting version
Comments support add, resolve, empty, failed, and permission-denied states
Backlinks and planning conversion remain visible from detail/history contexts
anti_patterns: Restore as one-click destructive action
Diff colors inaccessible or ambiguous
Comments hidden behind tiny icon only
Backlinks listed without source context
incentive: Versioned docs make planning context auditable and reversible.

title: Planning workbench freeform, guided ACP, prototype, and approval coverage
intent: Manually simulate the planning surface from freeform docs and guided ACP sessions through technical plan, prototype/boilerplate artifacts, approval, and materialization.
acceptance: Freeform and guided planning paths are both discoverable and complete
Selected docs/context are visible before submission
Generated plan includes prototype/boilerplate targets, success criteria, and approval controls
Materialization shows docs/tasks/dependencies that will be created before committing
anti_patterns: Planning as text-only generator with no review loop
Hidden context selection
Approval button without diff/preview
Materialization that creates tasks silently
manual_simulation: Run no-context and multi-doc planning flows
incentive: Planning is the bridge between docs and PM execution.

title: ACP session workbench model, mode, permission, traffic, and resume coverage
intent: Validate the ACP session workbench controls for agent selection, model/mode changes, permission dialogs, traffic monitor, resume/cancel, and empty session states.
acceptance: Agent/session list shows status, cwd, model, mode, permission state, and latest activity
Mode/model changes have immediate validation and audit feedback
Permission requests block execution with explicit approve/deny controls
Traffic monitor filters tool calls, stderr/stdout, and user messages without losing chronology
anti_patterns: Agent run controls without permission visibility
Traffic log as unstructured text dump only
Cancel/resume buttons with ambiguous disabled states
Mobile form with 17 inputs in one undifferentiated column
manual_simulation: Seed no sessions, active session, waiting permission, failed session
incentive: Agent-native value depends on transparent controllable sessions.

title: Run list/detail lifecycle, logs, artifacts, and retry coverage
intent: Manually test agent run list and detail surfaces for lifecycle statuses, log streams, retries, cancellation, artifacts, trace links, and empty/error states.
acceptance: Runs table supports filtering by status/project/agent and preserves trace links
Detail shows ordered lifecycle events, logs, artifacts, task/doc links, and criteria
Cancel/retry actions require appropriate confirmation and show result state
Empty and failed log stream states are explicit
anti_patterns: Status badges without timestamps or progress context
Retry action that duplicates runs without lineage
Logs auto-scroll without user control
Artifacts disconnected from originating run
incentive: Run detail is where humans decide whether agent work is trustworthy.

title: Dependency tree disclosure before agent execution coverage
intent: Ensure every task/board/project run button opens a clear dependency tree and impact review before queuing agent work.
acceptance: Dependency tree distinguishes required, optional, blocked, and already-complete work
User can inspect tasks before dispatch and cancel safely
Queued run order is shown before confirmation
After dispatch, tree links to created runs with shared trace IDs
anti_patterns: One-click run from board with no impact preview
Dependency graph rendered as inaccessible canvas only
Blocked dependencies hidden until after dispatch
No lineage between preview and created runs
manual_simulation: Seed simple, deep, and cyclic dependency examples
incentive: Dependency disclosure prevents unsafe autonomous execution.

title: Artifacts list, detail, preview, download, archive, and error coverage
intent: Validate artifacts as reviewable outputs of planning/runs, including filtering, preview by type, download safety, archive restore, and missing blob recovery.
acceptance: Artifact list filters by project/run/task/kind/archive state with counts
Detail previews text/markdown/image/binary fallbacks safely
Download/open actions handle missing file, permission, and storage errors
Archived artifacts are clearly hidden/restorable with audit trail
anti_patterns: API 404 presented as empty artifact list
Unsafe inline rendering for arbitrary content
Download button with no size/checksum context
Archived state indistinguishable from deleted
manual_simulation: Seed artifacts of multiple MIME types
incentive: Artifacts are the tangible outputs users review before closure.

title: Review workbench diff, annotation, suggestion, export, and live review coverage
intent: Manually test Plannotator-style review controls across diff tree, line selection, annotations, suggestions, feedback export, AI/agent tabs, and live logs.
acceptance: File tree, diff pane, annotation sidebar, search, suggestions, and export all work with keyboard
Line-level annotation creation and resolution are obvious
Feedback export includes selected context and target run/task/doc links
Empty/no-diff and very-large-diff states remain usable
anti_patterns: Diff-only page without workflow decisions
Annotation target ambiguous after scrolling
AI tab placeholder with no state or affordance
Search results disconnected from file tree
manual_simulation: Seed no diff, small diff, large diff
incentive: Review is the feedback loop preventing bad automated changes from closing.

title: UAT and code review handoff decision coverage
intent: Validate the user-facing handoff for UAT/code review, including manual approval, feedback, configured auto-decision, generated tests, and blocked states.
acceptance: UAT screen shows criteria, docs, tasks, runs, artifacts, and open feedback status
Approve/reject/rethink decisions require clear rationale where needed
Generated E2E proposal is previewed before materialization/run
Blocked reviewer/agent states are truthful and recoverable
anti_patterns: Single approve button without criteria context
Generated E2E hidden behind backend-only action
Auto-approval with no audit trail
Feedback text area disconnected from next agent run
manual_simulation: Seed passing, failing, and blocked final QA
incentive: Final human approval must be explicit, inspectable, and test-backed.

title: Repository index/detail metadata and connection state coverage
intent: Manually test repository browsing surfaces for list, detail, branch/commit/file links, connection errors, empty state, and project association.
acceptance: Repo list shows project linkage, local path, default branch, last scan, and health
Detail links to branches, commits, files, and associated tasks/runs
Disconnected/missing repo paths provide recovery steps
Mobile layout preserves path and action readability
anti_patterns: Repo row with only name and no operational state
Connection errors hidden until file browser opens
Long paths overflow page
Project association not visible
manual_simulation: Seed no repos, healthy repo, missing path repo
incentive: Repos are the source substrate for tasks, agents, and artifacts.

title: Repository file tree, file viewer, branch, commit, and blame coverage
intent: Validate Git browsing interactions including tree expansion, file preview, branch switching, commit pagination/detail, diff/blame view, and binary/error fallbacks.
acceptance: Tree navigation preserves selected path and handles large directories
File viewer supports text, markdown/code, binary, too-large, and missing-file states
Branch switching and commit pagination retain route context
Commit detail links changed files to viewer/diff and task/run context where available
anti_patterns: Full-page reload loses expanded tree every click
Binary files render as broken text
Branch actions without confirmation/recovery
Diff lines too small or unwrapped on mobile
manual_simulation: Use repo with nested dirs and binary file
incentive: Agents and humans need inspectable source context without leaving Fulcrum.

title: Search query, facets, saved searches, and contextual result coverage
intent: Manually simulate full search across tasks, docs, runs, artifacts, memory, and repos with facets, saved searches, result previews, no-results, and error states.
acceptance: Search input, scope, facets, and sort controls update result count visibly
Results show type, snippet, project/context, and destination action
Saved searches support create, run, rename/delete states
No-results suggests query/facet reset and relevant creation paths
anti_patterns: Ten inputs with unclear purpose
Facet chips without keyboard removal
Result snippets lacking source type/context
Search errors rendered as empty results
manual_simulation: Search with empty, common, and nonsense terms
incentive: Search/memory/context is core to local-first workflow continuity.

title: Memory and context preview selection coverage
intent: Validate memory list/detail and context preview surfaces used to assemble agent/planning context, including source links, filters, inclusion toggles, and empty/error states.
acceptance: Memory rows show source, recency, project/task/doc/run linkage, and confidence/provenance
Context preview explains exactly what will be sent to agent/planning flows
Include/exclude controls are reversible and persisted only when confirmed
Empty and stale context states include recovery or rebuild action
anti_patterns: Opaque context blob without source refs
Memory facts editable without provenance warning
Context selection hidden inside planning submit
No way to inspect excluded items
incentive: Agents need explainable context, not invisible prompt assembly.

title: Inbox notifications, read state, filters, and settings escalation coverage
intent: Manually test notification inbox behavior, unread counts, filtering, mark-read/all-read, deep links, delivery errors, and notification settings handoff.
acceptance: Inbox shows unread/read grouping, source type, severity, timestamp, and target link
Mark read/all read operations update count and row state with rollback on failure
Notification settings/channel errors link back to actionable recovery
Empty inbox is calm but still points to notification configuration
anti_patterns: 500 notification settings endpoint hidden behind healthy inbox
Notifications without source or destination
Mark-all-read without undo or confirmation for large batches
Mobile unread controls too small
incentive: Inbox is the human supervision feed for agents and workflows.

title: Audit log filtering, inspection, and failure-state coverage
intent: Validate audit log as an inspectable trust surface with filters, event detail, source links, pagination, export, and API failure recovery.
acceptance: Audit entries show actor, action, target, timestamp, trace ID, and source route/run/task
Filters by actor/action/target/time update count and URL state
Event detail exposes payload safely and links to related surfaces
502/500 states show recovery and retry, not raw server errors
anti_patterns: Audit page as raw JSON dump
No trace-link clickthrough
Server failure rendered as generic blank page
Filters reset on pagination
manual_simulation: Seed workflow and settings audit entries
incentive: Auditability is required before autonomous actions are credible.

title: Doctor health, environment recovery, and local runtime checks coverage
intent: Manually test doctor UI for server/API/PGlite/inference/env health, recovery instructions, rerun controls, and mobile scanability.
acceptance: Doctor identifies missing FULCRUM_FEATURES, FULCRUM_SERVER_URL, FULCRUM_PUBLIC_API_URL, and stale PGlite lock states
Each failed check includes exact recovery command/context without destructive auto-action
Rerun/check controls show progress and updated timestamp
Mobile doctor remains readable as a checklist
anti_patterns: Crash text like Aborted() without recovery
Environment requirements buried in docs only
Green page while API feature gate returns 404
Checks with no last-run timestamp
manual_simulation: Launch with missing public API env
Create stale lock scenario in disposable home
incentive: Local-first app needs self-diagnosis when setup/runtime drift occurs.

title: Feature flags table, cohort rules, toggle, and failure coverage
intent: Validate feature flag controls with dense table editing, cohort/rule configuration, toggles, audit feedback, mobile behavior, and server URL error recovery.
acceptance: Flag list supports search/filter/group with visible enabled and rollout states
Toggle, cohort edit, and experiment edit states show pending/success/error feedback
Missing public API URL surfaces recovery rather than 500
Mobile layout avoids 58-input wall without grouping
anti_patterns: Large ungrouped flag form/table
Toggle with no confirmation for risky flags
Web self-calls /api/v1 and shows 500 when server URL missing
Mobile table overflow without labels
incentive: Feature flag settings are a high-risk control plane and need robust UX.

title: Routing and orchestration settings rule-builder coverage
intent: Manually test routing rules and orchestration workflow settings for rule creation, priority ordering, matching preview, delete confirmation, and broken backend recovery.
acceptance: Rules show priority, matcher, target agent/model, enabled state, and last matched status
Users can preview which rule matches sample input before saving
Reordering and delete actions have explicit confirmation/undo where needed
Backend 500/empty states provide recovery and preserve unsaved edits
anti_patterns: Rules as opaque JSON blobs
Priority changes without visual order feedback
Delete/reorder as tiny icon-only buttons with no labels
Internal error page for invalid workflow
incentive: Routing controls decide which agents act, so misconfiguration must be hard.

title: Connectors and integrations setup, sync log, and credential-state coverage
intent: Validate connectors, webhooks, importers, and external integration settings for setup flows, auth state, sync log, test connection, and failure remediation.
acceptance: Each connector shows configured/unconfigured/error/syncing states
Test connection and sync actions show progress and detailed recovery
Secrets/API keys are never echoed after save
Sync log entries link to imported projects/tasks/docs where relevant
anti_patterns: Connector cards with static marketing descriptions only
Credentials visible in plain text
Sync failures with no source record
Import wizard using hidden feature gates with no explanation
incentive: External integrations expand value only when setup and failures are transparent.

title: Theme, compact mode, color, and accessibility preference coverage
intent: Manually verify visual preference controls including preset, accent, border radius, font, color scheme, compact mode, and animation across core screens.
acceptance: Theme changes preview immediately and persist after reload
Compact/animation/color scheme choices visibly affect dashboard, board, docs, and settings
Contrast remains acceptable in each preset and accent choice
Reset/default action is clear and non-destructive
anti_patterns: Theme page as isolated preview not applied to product screens
Accent color creating low-contrast buttons/badges
Animation setting ignored by interactive components
No mobile preview for density changes
manual_simulation: Apply each preset and inspect dashboard/board/docs
incentive: Theme controls should improve repeated-use comfort without breaking clarity.

title: API keys, secrets, data, backups, errors, telemetry, and database settings coverage
intent: Validate administrative settings with high-risk controls: API keys, secrets, backup/import/export, error logs, telemetry, database migrations, and destructive recovery states.
acceptance: Sensitive values are masked, copyable only when intended, and never logged in UI errors
Backup/import/export flows show scope, size, progress, success, and rollback/retry guidance
Migrations page distinguishes pending/applied/failed with exact recovery steps
Telemetry controls clearly explain local/remote data implications
anti_patterns: Secrets displayed in table cells
Backup import as one-click destructive action
Migration failure shown as raw stack only
Settings API page advertising endpoints that return 404
incentive: Admin controls can destroy trust if unsafe or opaque.

title: Authentication login, signup, logout, invite, and passkey coverage
intent: Manually simulate auth routes and forms, including validation, passkey/browser failure, invitation tokens, session expiry, and mobile keyboard behavior.
acceptance: Login/signup forms show field-level validation, submit loading, and credential/passkey failures
Invite route handles valid, expired, used, and unknown tokens
Session expiry redirects preserve attempted destination where safe
Mobile forms keep password/passkey actions visible above keyboard
anti_patterns: Generic auth failed with no recovery
Passkey unsupported browser crash
Invite token 500 instead of friendly expired/invalid screen
Auth redirects losing user context
manual_simulation: Desktop and mobile auth form fill
incentive: Auth failures block all product workflows and must be recoverable.

title: Project settings suite modules, views, intake, templates, import, statuses, memory, connectors coverage
intent: Inventory and test the dense project settings suite that configures PM behavior, including CRUD detail routes, module/view/intake settings, importers, templates, statuses, memory, and connectors.
acceptance: Every settings module has list/create/edit/delete/empty/error/manual-save states where applicable
Nested view/module/intake detail routes preserve project context and back navigation
Import/settings flows preview impact before creating data
Mobile settings uses grouped navigation instead of overwhelming forms
anti_patterns: Scattered project settings with inconsistent buttons and labels
Create/delete behavior differs between modules without reason
Importer wizard without dry-run preview
Nested settings route loses project shell
manual_simulation: Seed empty and populated project settings
Keyboard create/edit/delete one entity per module
incentive: Project settings make manual PM complete without direct database or CLI intervention.

title: Reports, charts, portfolio, and analytics interaction coverage
intent: Validate report dashboards and charts for filters, date ranges, empty data, drilldowns, chart accessibility, portfolio comparison, and mobile rendering.
acceptance: Date and scope filters update all charts with visible applied state
Charts provide table/text equivalents and handle empty data gracefully
Portfolio table supports sort/filter/drilldown into project/task/run context
Mobile charts remain legible or switch to compact summaries
anti_patterns: Charts without labels, legends, or accessible data alternative
Empty report area with no explanation
Date picker hidden behind unlabeled icon
Portfolio metrics detached from action links
manual_simulation: Seed no data, normal sprint, and overloaded project
incentive: Analytics should help prioritize work, not just decorate reports.

title: Offline, error boundary, loading skeleton, and retry coverage
intent: Manually test cross-route resilience states including app-level error page, offline page, route loading, API failure retry, and internal-error redaction.
acceptance: App-level errors show route, recovery, retry/back actions, and no stack trace in normal UI
Offline page explains local-first state and what remains available
Major data routes show loading skeletons and retry controls
HTTP 500/502/404 states are distinct and actionable
anti_patterns: Internal stack traces or raw JSON errors visible to users
Blank successful 200 page used as error fallback
Retry button without backoff or status
Offline state that implies all data is lost
incentive: A local-first developer tool must recover gracefully from expected runtime failures.

title: Cross-surface mobile interaction and overflow audit
intent: Create a manual mobile simulation matrix covering all high-density screens, controls, modals, tables, editors, command palette, and settings forms.
acceptance: All primary workflows have a defined mobile layout or explicit unsupported-state message
No text/control overlap at 320, 375, 768, and 1024 px widths
Tables, boards, editors, and logs use purposeful mobile alternatives
Modals/drawers trap and restore focus correctly on mobile
anti_patterns: Desktop table squeezed onto phone
Hidden action buttons requiring hover
Form labels separated from inputs on narrow width
Dialog taller than viewport without internal scroll
manual_simulation: Capture screenshots for dashboard, projects, docs, board, task detail, agents, settings flags, review
Run keyboard and touch-like pointer checks
Inspect long labels and error messages
incentive: Mobile checks catch layout failures before they spread across route families.

title: Global empty, loading, permission, not-found, and error-state inventory
intent: Require manual e2e simulation for every major route family under empty data, populated data, no-results filters, permission denied, not found, API 500, and network failure.
acceptance: Each route family has named fixtures for empty, populated, filtered-empty, forbidden, missing, and failed states
Every state includes primary next action and route-appropriate recovery
Automated screenshots are captured for high-priority empty/error states
No route returns successful 200 with blank body for normal empty data
anti_patterns: One generic Empty component reused without route-specific action
HTTP status failure hidden behind blank successful page
Permission errors indistinguishable from missing data
No manual smoke screenshot for state variants
manual_simulation: Build fixture table by route family
Capture one screenshot per state per critical family
Keyboard operate retry and reset actions
incentive: State coverage turns broad route inventory into a reliable product QA matrix.

title: Keyboard, focus, ARIA, and screen-reader interaction audit
intent: Create manual accessibility simulations for keyboard-only use, focus order, ARIA labels, dialogs, live regions, drag alternatives, charts, editor blocks, and log streams.
acceptance: Every interactive control family has keyboard path and visible focus state
Dialogs/menus/palettes trap focus and restore it after close
Drag/drop, charts, logs, and editors expose accessible alternatives or announcements
Icon-only controls have labels and tooltips where meaning is not obvious
anti_patterns: Hover-only row actions
Icon buttons without accessible names
Drag-only status changes
Live updates with no pause or announcement control
manual_simulation: Run keyboard path on dashboard, board, docs editor, review, settings
Use accessibility tree snapshot for icon buttons
incentive: Agent-native tools still need human-safe accessible controls.
